parameters.name: BasePath
parameters.description: The root path for APIs in this group.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: A description of the API group. It can be up to 180 characters long.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The group name. It must be unique and can contain only letters, digits, underscores, and Chinese characters. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. Its length must be 4 to 50 characters.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The object tags to which the rule applies. You can specify multiple tags.
